name: Task Stamps — Stamp Set
description: Worlds and characters for the Task Stamps habit tracker. Each character brings a portrait, optional Boss artwork and defeat sound, an optional signature sound, exactly fifteen ordered stamp images earned by completing tasks, and optionally ten ranked square goal images shown along a goal's track. Characters should belong to the selected worlds.

entitySelections.label: Worlds
entitySelections.hint: The worlds the stamp characters come from. Each needs a cover for the world picker.

assetSets.label: World cover
assetSets.hint: Shown in the world library and pickers.

entitySelections.label: Characters
entitySelections.hint: Characters that hand out stamps. A character is only usable once all fifteen stamps are present.

assetSets.label: Portrait
assetSets.hint: Shown in the character library and on assignment cards.

assetSets.label: Boss image
assetSets.hint: Optional. Shown in the rotating daily Boss banner; images of any dimensions are accepted and fitted into the widescreen banner.

assetSets.label: Boss defeat sound
assetSets.hint: Optional. Played after the normal stamp sounds when this character's daily Boss is defeated.

assetSets.label: Stamps — fifteen, in order
assetSets.hint: The fifteen stamp images in earning order: slot 1 is the first stamp a task completion can award.

assetSets.label: Goal images — ten, in rank order
assetSets.hint: Optional, but all ten or none. Square images in rank order: image 1 shows for the first 10% of a goal's track, image 10 for the last. A character carries goals only once all ten are present.

assetSets.label: Signature sound
assetSets.hint: Optional. Played when a stamp without its own sound is placed.

assetSets.label: Per-stamp sounds
assetSets.hint: Optional sounds for individual stamps. Set each sound's stamp number.

itemFields.label: Stamp number
itemFields.hint: Which stamp (1–15) this sound belongs to.
